sentences.text: For Petitioner(s) : Mr. B.L. Choudhary For Respondent(s) : Mr. N.S. Chandawat, PP  Mr. Shambhoo Singh Rathore for  complainant  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MUKESH RAJPUROHIT Order 04/09/2025 1.
This petition has been filed by the petitioners for quashing of the FIR No.295/2018, registered at Police Station Pratapnagar, District Udaipur with all consequential proceedings.

2. Learned Public Prosecutor while producing the factual report, sent by the SHO, Police Station Pratapnagar, District Udaipur, submits that after investigation in the present case, the Investigating Officer has found the offences under Sections 448, 453, 420, 427 & 120B IPC made out against the petitioners and (Uploaded on 13/09/2025 at 04:49:25 PM) [2025:RJ-JD:39566] (2 of 2)
[CRLMP-3167/2018] the charge-sheet has already been filed on 15.06.2021 before the competent criminal Court.
3.

In this background and, considering the limited scope of interference in an FIR at the initial stage while exercising the inherent powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C., this Court is not inclined to quash Mangilal vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:39566) on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73934086/
1 the impugned FIR.
Needless to say that the petitioners shall be at liberty to raise all their objections before the trial court at the appropriate stage.
4. With these observations and directions, the instant misc. petition as well as stay application are disposed of with liberty as prayed for.
5. The factual report, sent by the SHO Police Station Pratapnagar is taken on record.
